Indicator: Summary of the content moderation engaged in at the providers’ own initiative
Value:
Square Enix moderates the content in the FFXIV live service game via the in game reporting functionality. Players can readily report any illegal content through the game's interface and such information is then reviewed by Square Enix to decide whether an action is required to be taken or not, in accordance with its T&Cs.
Reporting functionalities are also present on the FFXIV Lodestone and FFXIV Forums.
